metaDescription: Order custom bottle buttons, stickers, and patches for bulk promotions. Perfect for events and branding. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom bottle buttons, stickers, and patches give you a unique way to brand reusable water bottles or promotional drinkware. Unlike standard buttons, bottle-shaped designs stand out at trade shows, company picnics, or safety events. Choose from 1" or 1.5" lapel pins, 3" buttons, or plantable ribbon pins to match your campaign. Add your logo with full-color imprinting for a memorable giveaway that attendees can attach to bags or lanyards.
